sentences.en: As far as this matter is concerned, I am satisfied.
sentences.zh: 就这件事而言，我感到满意。

sentences.en: I am by no means satisfied with my present income.
sentences.zh: 我对目前的收入一点也不满意。

sentences.en: His explanation that a solution would take time didn't satisfy anyone.
sentences.zh: 他解释说需要时间才能找到解决方案，这并不能让人信服。

senses.zh: 使确信符合，达到(要求、规定、标准等)
